name: Vent integrations
ownerWords:
an IMPORTANT feature of vent is to check, notify whether each integration is active (especially the flaky ones). have a green light thing, track stats success percent, and alert when failure rates increase

make it work if there are any issues discovered, or there are quirks like bad call stack, unreliable shit, throughput issues when scaled

verify locally, deploy to staging & prod.
goal: Prod Vent calls succeed at least 99% of the time over 24 h, not counting the caller's own 4xx, both Vent hosts answer 200 on /healthz, no integration shows a red light on the prod console. These are the problems that kept coming back in the vent chat: prod upstream 429 and 5xx failures kept success at 94.6 to 98% on all 40 Vent gateway runs since 10-18 22:04Z; expired or invalid provider credentials hit 6 times (the Stripe test key, the Instagram token, prod Resend's 403, Clerk's server-side token, an encrypted Convex webhook secret, customer-token 401s); CLIProxy 502s and Claude model fallbacks hit 4 times; and failed lands and promotes held prod Vent on an old build 11 times from 10-18 to 10-19 (lands 39, 40, 43, 46, 48, 49, 50, 51 and 54's staging deploy, promotes 12 and 14). The precheck vent-integrations.ts builds the prod lights and the 24 h success with Vent's own vent.health code, the code behind the console's /_vent/admin/health, so a call counts as the console counts it: success and failure only, without the caller's own 4xx, the Claude account cap, refused and cancelled calls. No source address sends prod Vent a key it refuses as vent_unauthorized, counted by client.address with any caller and without the Railway services duty's daily revoke proofs (user agent vent-breach-check/1), because the console leaves refused calls out: from 02:09Z on 10-25 the prod host services exporter on us-metal01 (64.34.205.243) got 401 on every Railway and Vercel call, the panels froze, and this duty read 100%. Release lag runs from the later of prod first logging its /healthz build and staging last logging it, read from service.version on Vent's OTel rows. Each run also reads the Vent Grafana folder: a false alert gets its condition changed, and a problem no alert caught gets a new alert. No prod or staging Vent call names a model older than the newest of its tier, let through or refused as vent_model_not_allowed, because under owner rule c185 (10-28, "vent should constrain models (cliproxy, API) to use ONLY THE LATEST MODEL of each tier ... nothing else should be allowed. period.") Vent allows only ALLOWED_MODELS in apps/vent/src/vent/tables.py, and the console leaves refused calls out: in the 7 days to 10-27 17:48Z, 25 model names outside the allowed set went through Vent, claude-opus-5 in 52,913 calls and gpt-6-sol in 39,899, and on 10-28 at 06:18Z the 24 h before the allowlist shipped still held 1,335 such prod calls and 13,453 on staging. old_model_calls_24h counts them from otel.vent_calls the way the vent-model-allowlist session's vent_models_query.py does, and on 10-28 it replaced vent_model_refused_callers, which counted only callers Vent refused, so an older model on a path Vent does not check read as 0. Since 10-28 the duty keeps one headline and 3 more metrics (c75): red_integrations_prod, vent_hosts_down and prod_vent_behind_staging_h stay in the precheck output as run detail, and prod_vent_behind_staging_h is no reading of d2 any more, because under owner rule c154 (10-22) the release owner walks each prod promote with the owner and no Vent job can move it. None of the 17 reads the prod Vent console runs costs 1 core-second or more on prod ClickHouse (goal p44, owner: "Make the Vent Grafana panels and alert rules cheap so they stop loading prod's database"): vent-console-cost.py builds them with Vent's own telemetry_read and health code at origin/main, runs each once and reads its CPU from otel.query_cost. Before release 21 (10-25) four 24 h usage reads took 1.07 to 1.50 core-s because each decoded the whole LogAttributes map; after it the slowest took 0.51.

metrics.label: Prod Vent call success over 24 h, without the caller's own 4xx
Source addresses whose keyed prod Vent calls were refused as vent_unauthorized in 24 h
Reads the prod Vent console runs that cost 1 core-second or more on prod ClickHouse (usage and calls over 1 h and 24 h, health lights)
Prod and staging Vent calls in 24 h that named a model older than the newest of its tier, let through or refused (c185)

onMiss: Steer the live job on the fix step for the missed metric, or start one fix job when none is live, with the metric's name in its brief. vent_success_24h_pct under 99: read the call_failed rows and send the largest outcome by integration to the p25 job 'vent prod call failures'. vent_success_24h_pct at -1 means prod Vent took no calls in 24 h, which follows the hosts. A red_light row in the run detail (red_integrations_prod above 0): read the red_light rows, or the prod console's lights when there are more than 3; an expired or invalid credential gets a new key into Vent's tier file and keeper store, or a For you todo only when the owner's own sign-in is needed, and a CLIProxy or upstream outage gets a retry or fallback fix in Vent. A behind_staging row only names both builds and since when: prod moves at the release owner's walks with the owner (c154), so it never starts a promote, a catch-up job or a fix step. vent_key_refused_sources above 0: read the key_refused rows, find the service on that address that holds the wrong Vent key (the integrations it asked for name it), and steer or start one job to give it the key from Vent's tier file. old_model_calls_24h above 0: read the old_model rows, which name each tier, caller, operation and older model with how many calls Vent let through or refused, and steer or start one job to move that caller to the newest model of its tier in the caller's own code (c185), never to widen Vent's allowlist. A row Vent let through after the allowlist shipped means a path Vent does not check, so that job also makes Vent refuse it. The count is a 24 h window, so calls from before a fix age out within a day; lastEventAt names the newest one. A host_down row (vent_hosts_down above 0): read the container logs on the box and redeploy Vent through the p23 job 'vent release driver'. vent_console_slow_reads_24h above 0: read the slow_console_read rows and steer or start one fix step under p44 ('Make the Vent Grafana panels and alert rules cheap'): read the slow read's SQL in apps/vent/src/vent/telemetry_read.py or health.py, give otel.vent_calls a MATERIALIZED column or a rollup for the LogAttributes key it decodes (ops/schema/vent-calls.sql, applied on prod by the metal box owner) and point the read at it, measured with apps/infra/grafana/query_cost.py before and after. A false alert in the Vent Grafana folder gets its condition changed, and a miss no alert caught gets a new rule. A source_error row means a source was not read, so fix the read first. No outside sends (c37). Jobs land to staging on their own and leave prod promotes to the release owner (c154). All on target: end the turn with no message.
